changes_from_v2: RETAINED: DELIVERY_LATE, DELIVERY_MISSING, DELIVERY_TRACKING (4 delivery intents -> 3)

primary_intents.name: Late Delivery
primary_intents.definition: Customer's package has not arrived by the expected delivery date or is delayed
primary_intents.stress_test_notes: Most common delivery issue. Carrier issues treated as context.

primary_intents.name: Missing/Not Delivered
primary_intents.definition: Customer never received package, shows delivered but not there, or package lost
primary_intents.stress_test_notes: Distinct from late - requires different action path

primary_intents.name: Tracking Issue
primary_intents.definition: Customer cannot track package, tracking info wrong/unclear, or needs tracking help

primary_intents.name: Order Inquiry/Modification
primary_intents.definition: Customer wants to know order status OR wants to modify/cancel order
primary_intents.stress_test_notes: Merged due to low ORDER_MODIFY count (9 examples). Status inquiry and modification are related.

primary_intents.name: App/Technical Issue
primary_intents.definition: Problem using Amazon app, website, or technical issue including login/access problems
primary_intents.stress_test_notes: Merged due to high overlap (32). Login via app is still app issue.

primary_intents.name: Device Problem
primary_intents.definition: Issue with Amazon device (Kindle, Fire TV, Echo, Alexa) or video streaming on device
primary_intents.stress_test_notes: Merged - VIDEO_STREAMING often involves specific device. Low overlap (10).

primary_intents.name: Refund or Payment Issue
primary_intents.definition: Customer wants money back, has billing problem, or payment issue
primary_intents.stress_test_notes: Merged - high overlap (19) and related. Payment issues lead to refund.

primary_intents.name: Return/Exchange/Product Issue
primary_intents.definition: Customer wants to return item, exchange, or has product quality issue (wrong, damaged, defective)
primary_intents.stress_test_notes: Merged due to very high overlap (32). Product issue always leads to return.

primary_intents.name: Account/Seller/Other
primary_intents.definition: Account issues not related to app/technical, seller issues, marketplace questions, or general inquiries

context_modifiers.name: Prime Customer
context_modifiers.definition: Customer is a Prime member - affects delivery expectations

context_modifiers.name: Marketplace/Region
context_modifiers.definition: Customer using Amazon.in, Amazon.fr, Amazon.de, Amazon.uk, etc.

context_modifiers.name: Delivery Carrier Issue
context_modifiers.definition: Issue specifically with delivery carrier (Gati, FedEx, etc.)
context_modifiers.usage: Add as modifier to DELIVERY intents
context_modifiers.notes: Was separate leaf intent in v2, now demoted to modifier due to stress test

escalation_signals.name: High Frustration
escalation_signals.definition: Customer expresses anger, frustration, or strong negative emotion

escalation_signals.name: Previous Unresolved Contact
escalation_signals.definition: Customer mentions contacting before with no resolution

escalation_signals.name: Escalation Request
escalation_signals.definition: Customer explicitly asks for manager, supervisor, or callback

escalation_signals.name: Service Quality Complaint
escalation_signals.definition: Customer complains about Amazon service quality or rude behavior
escalation_signals.action: Log for quality tracking, consider escalation

proposed_hierarchy:
PROPOSED HIERARCHY V3 (9 leaf intents):

TOP LEVEL (5 categories):
├── DELIVERY (35-40%)
│   ├── DELIVERY_LATE
│   ├── DELIVERY_MISSING
│   └── DELIVERY_TRACKING
├── ORDER (10-15%)
│   └── ORDER_STATUS (includes modification)
├── TECHNICAL (25-30%)
│   ├── APP_TECHNICAL (includes login/access)
│   └── DEVICE_ISSUE (includes video streaming)
├── PAYMENT (8-12%)
│   └── REFUND_REQUEST (includes payment issues)
└── RETURN_PRODUCT (6-10%)
    └── RETURN_REQUEST (includes product issues)

MODIFIERS: PRIME_CUSTOMER, MARKETPLACE, DELIVERY_CARRIER

SIGNALS: FRUSTRATION_HIGH, PREVIOUS_CONTACT, ESCALATION_REQUEST, SERVICE_COMPLAINT

DELIVERY_LATE.inclusion: Customer states package is late, delayed, or not arrived by expected date
DELIVERY_LATE.exclusion: Package shows delivered but customer says not received -> DELIVERY_MISSING. Cannot track -> DELIVERY_TRACKING
DELIVERY_LATE.priority: If 'late' AND 'tracking' both present, prefer DELIVERY_LATE

DELIVERY_MISSING.inclusion: Customer says package shows delivered but not received, never received, or is lost
DELIVERY_MISSING.exclusion: Package is simply late -> DELIVERY_LATE. Need tracking help -> DELIVERY_TRACKING
DELIVERY_MISSING.priority: If 'not delivered' AND 'late' both present, prefer DELIVERY_MISSING

DELIVERY_TRACKING.inclusion: Customer cannot find tracking info, tracking shows wrong status, needs tracking number
DELIVERY_TRACKING.exclusion: Package is late -> DELIVERY_LATE. Package missing -> DELIVERY_MISSING
DELIVERY_TRACKING.priority: Only use if tracking is the PRIMARY problem, not accompaniment

ORDER_STATUS.inclusion: Customer asks about order status, wants to modify/cancel order
ORDER_STATUS.exclusion: This is about a delivery issue -> DELIVERY_* instead
ORDER_STATUS.priority: If 'order' AND 'delivery' both prominent, use DELIVERY_*

APP_TECHNICAL.inclusion: Problem with app, website, login, access, or general technical issue
APP_TECHNICAL.priority: Login/access problems are APP_TECHNICAL even if on mobile

DEVICE_ISSUE.inclusion: Problem with Kindle, Fire TV, Echo, Alexa, or video streaming on Amazon devices
DEVICE_ISSUE.priority: If device name mentioned + technical issue, prefer DEVICE_ISSUE

REFUND_REQUEST.inclusion: Customer wants money back, has billing issue, or payment problem
REFUND_REQUEST.exclusion: Customer wants to return item -> RETURN_REQUEST
REFUND_REQUEST.priority: If 'refund' AND 'return' both present, prefer RETURN_REQUEST

RETURN_REQUEST.inclusion: Customer wants to return item, exchange, or has product quality issue
RETURN_REQUEST.priority: Product quality issues are RETURN_REQUEST even if no explicit return mentioned

ACCOUNT_OTHER.inclusion: Account issues not fitting APP_TECHNICAL, seller questions, marketplace issues

ORDER_STATUS_vs_DELIVERY_TRACKING.rule: ORDER_STATUS = asking about order existence/status. DELIVERY_TRACKING = cannot find tracking info or tracking wrong.

DELIVERY_CARRIER.rule: Demote from leaf intent to MODIFIER. Add as context to DELIVERY_* when carrier is specifically mentioned.
DELIVERY_CARRIER.decision: MERGE into DELIVERY category as modifier

APP_USAGE_vs_ACCOUNT_ACCESS.rule: Login/access via app is APP_TECHNICAL. Login issues are not distinct enough to separate.

PRODUCT_ISSUE_vs_RETURN_REQUEST.rule: Product issue almost always leads to return request. Merge into RETURN_REQUEST.

REFUND_REQUEST_vs_PAYMENT_ISSUE.rule: Payment issues lead to refund. Keep as single intent REFUND_REQUEST.

DEVICE_ISSUE_vs_VIDEO_STREAMING.rule: Video streaming often on specific device. Merge into DEVICE_ISSUE.

weakest_intents.issue: Low volume, often accompanies other delivery intents
weakest_intents.recommendation: Keep - useful for routing specific troubleshooting

weakest_intents.issue: Catch-all category may be too vague
weakest_intents.recommendation: Keep but monitor - may need future split
